ios.desc: Floret Analysis delivers comprehensive commodities trading insights and analysis directly to your fingertips. Developed by Floret Commodities, a trusted PMEX member since 2015, our app brings professional-grade market intelligence to traders of all experience levels.

quotes.text:
Location: Lahore, Pakistan (GMT+5, overlaps EU fully, US mornings)

Remote: Remote only

Willing to relocate: Yes, with visa sponsorship

Technologies: TypeScript, React, Next.js, React Native (Expo), Node.js, Express, Nest.js, Python/Django, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Redis, MongoDB, Supabase, Docker, Nginx, AWS S3, GitHub Actions CI/CD, WebSockets, REST APIs, microservices

Résumé/CV: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1YnzMKIi0KnecclOpo8AmtrCpS83TU-vY/view?usp=sharing

Email: umermehmood3000@gmail.com

Full stack engineer, 2+ years, currently lead developer on a real-time broker app.

Highlights:

- Shipped Floret Analysis end to end — a React Native trading app live on both the App Store and Play Store. Live WebSocket market data, dynamic charting, biometric auth, push notifications, native module bridging: https://apps.apple.com/pk/app/floret-analysis-for-pmex/id6745098959

- Scaled Anewswire, a Django/Next.js press platform, past 20,000 active users with RSS pipelines and a custom CMS.

- Architected Contfly, a Nest.js microservice platform integrating 6+ social APIs behind a gateway.

- LLM tooling in production, not just in the editor: Claude Code as my primary driver, bulk generation on the Anthropic Batches API, and a deterministic metadata layer over ~700 generated pages — built specifically to bound where the model was allowed to be nondeterministic.

Available in 2-4 weeks. Open to contract or full-time.
